title: 第386章 不安的感觉很强烈
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

九尾天狐雕像脚下。

二女接受完传承，缓缓睁开了眼眸。

小灵儿兴奋得脸颊泛红，紧紧抓着香香的手臂，激动到有些语无伦次。

“香香姐姐，我的血脉进化到八尾了！”

“境界也提升了好多！！”

“幸亏有狐祖手令，要不然，我根本不可能接受到狐祖传承！”

“谢谢你，香香姐姐！”

小灵儿将狐祖手令递了过来。

香香接过来，收进了空间戒指当中。

她的心情，此刻也是格外的好！

今日三喜临门，爱情事业双丰收，而且还报了狐祖支脉世代的血仇。

这半日发生的事情，美妙到仿佛是一场梦，甚至…她做梦都不敢如此幻想！

小灵儿仰着小脸，一脸希冀，“回去后，我要好好修炼，以后终于能帮到陛下了，我再也不要当他的小拖油瓶！”

小灵儿攥紧了粉拳，神色格外坚定。

“是啊，我们终于可以帮到他了。”香香也是满眼憧憬。

她不要当他的附庸，她要成为站在他身边的女人。

“姐姐！”小灵儿古灵精怪的一笑，“你今日的幸运还没结束呢，晚上，才是你最期待的精彩节目。”

“这一天，终于要到了哦～”

香香白了小灵儿一眼，但粉眸中的喜色，却怎么也藏不住了。

既有忐忑，又有难掩的期待。

“放心吧，香香姐姐。”

“你这么漂亮，那色狼，一定很喜欢你的～以后，只要我们两姐妹团结起来，后宫谁都不是我们的对手，谁都不能把陛下从我们身边抢走！！”

“以后她们想和陛下睡觉，必须经过我们的允许！”

小灵儿凶凶的挥了挥粉拳。

“到时候……”她的小脸突然泛红，“到时候，我们给他生小狐狸～”

香香气呼呼的敲了敲小灵儿的脑门，“你的小脑袋瓜里，每天想的都是什么！”

“哎呀！”小灵儿一脸委屈地捂着额头。

“香香！你！你不识好歹！！！”

“本小姐这是为你着想，反正本小姐已经吃过肉了，你如果不需要帮忙那就算了，呜呜……”

“好啦好啦～”

香香早已迫不及待了，小脸上带着期待的绯红。

“传承已经结束，我们快离开吧，别让陛下等久了。”

“嗯嗯～”

Page (1/3)

At the foot of the Nine-tailed Sky Fox statue.

After accepting the inheritance, the two girls slowly opened their eyes.

Xiao Ling'er's cheeks turned red with excitement, and she clutched Xiangxiang's arm tightly, feeling a little incoherent with excitement.

"Sister Xiangxiang, my bloodline has evolved to the eight-tails!"

"The realm has also improved a lot!!"

"Fortunately, I have the Fox Ancestor's warrant, otherwise, it would be impossible for me to receive the Fox Ancestor's inheritance!"

"Thank you, Sister Xiangxiang!"

Xiao Ling'er handed over the Fox Ancestor's warrant.

Xiangxiang took it and put it into the space ring.

Her mood is particularly good at the moment!

Today, there are three blessings, a good harvest in love and career, and the blood revenge of the ancestor fox branch for generations has been avenged.

What happened in the past half day was so wonderful that it seemed like a dream, and even...she never dared to dream like this!

Little Ling'er raised her face with hope, "After I go back, I will practice hard so that I can finally help His Majesty. I will never be his little bastard again!"

Xiao Ling'er clenched her pink fists tightly, her expression extremely determined.

"Yes, we can finally help him." Xiangxiang was also full of longing.

She doesn't want to be his vassal, she wants to be the woman who stands by his side.

"Sister!" Xiao Ling'er smiled quirkily, "Your luck today is not over yet. Tonight is the exciting show you are most looking forward to."

"This day is finally here~"

Xiangxiang rolled her eyes at Xiao Ling'er, but she couldn't hide the joy in her pink eyes.

There is both anxiety and unconcealed anticipation.

"Don't worry, Sister Xiangxiang."

"You are so beautiful, that pervert must like you very much~ From now on, as long as we two sisters unite, no one in the harem will be our opponent, and no one can take His Majesty away from us!!"

"If they want to sleep with His Majesty from now on, they must get our permission!"

Xiao Ling'er waved her pink fist fiercely.

"When the time comes..." Her face suddenly turned red, "Then we will give him a little fox~"

Xiangxiang knocked on Xiao Ling'er's forehead, "What are you thinking about every day in your little head!"

"Ouch!" Xiao Ling'er covered her forehead with an aggrieved look.

"Xiangxiang! You! You don't know what is good and what is evil!!!"

"This lady is thinking about you. Anyway, I have already eaten meat. If you don't need help, forget it, wuwu..."

"Okay, okay~"

Xiangxiang couldn't wait any longer, with a blush of anticipation on her face.

"The inheritance has ended. Let's leave quickly. Don't keep His Majesty waiting too long."

"Hmm~"
